question: What is the full range of reality to be contemplated in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in every place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
This contemplation covers the entire range of manifestation.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
